body.title: feat: add EXPLAIN query plan command
body.body: ## Overview This PR implements the EXPLAIN query plan command feature requested in Issue #66. ## Problem Statement Users needed a way to understand how NexumDB would execute their SQL queries, including cache analysis, query optimization insights, and execution strategy recommendations. ## Solution Implemented a comprehensive EXPLAIN command that provides: - SQL query parsing and structure analysis - Query complexity calculation (0-10 scale) - Clause detection (WHERE, JOIN, ORDER BY, GROUP BY) - Semantic cache analysis with similarity scoring - RL agent Q-values and optimization recommendations - Execution strategy suggestions ## Implementation Details ### Modified Files #### nexum_ai/optim…
